warning.titlePre: Jaguar XK 4.2 V8 Timing Chain Tensioner Wear
paragraphs: If your XK 4.2 V8 is an X150-generation model with the AJ-V8 Gen III engine — covering the 2005 to 2014 production run — timing chain tensioner and guide wear is the single most frequently reported issue on this engine, backed by independent analysis of 2,500+ owner reports. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guides and water pump as standard on every AJ-V8 Gen III rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via multiple independent sources (au7o.io, rrsport.co.uk lawsuit list), per VRF-jaguar-xk.md. Applies to X150 4.2L V8 and 5.0L V8 variants.
